霓虹飞车

连接 pureTV 手柄

游戏已暂停，连接与端口保持。回到窗口后，松开按键再按 START。

怎么操作
↔

← → 转向 · ↓ 刹车 · 自动油门

A

手柄 A / X · Shift / 空格：漂移

B

手柄 B / Y · B / Ctrl：氮气

START / Enter 开始 · P 暂停 · R 重开
⌃⌘F 全屏 · 断线自动暂停

小提示

弯前减速，入弯再按漂移。每个检查点都要按顺序经过。

PURETV RACING CLUB

Neon Rush

Six racers. Two laps. Auto throttle keeps you moving. Drift to charge, release for a mini turbo, then unleash nitro.

CIRCUIT
Skyport Circuit
Seabreeze Switchback
Redrock Leap
START RACE · ENTER

Choose a circuit · B: sound · START / Enter: race

PURETV CONTROLLER
PAUSED

192.0.2.10:8765

CONNECT YOUR CONTROLLER

Game paused; connection and port are kept. Return to the window, release the buttons, then press START.

CONTROLS
↔

← → steer · ↓ brake · auto throttle

A

Pad A / X · Shift / Space: drift

B

Pad B / Y · B / Ctrl: nitro

START / Enter: race · P: pause · R: restart
⌃⌘F: full screen · disconnect pauses

RACE TIP

Brake before a corner, then drift. Pass every checkpoint in order.
